news.title: 21-year-old motorcyclist killed in Dunwoody crash
news.summary: A motorcyclist has died after a collision at Tilly Mill Road and East Madison Drive in Dunwoody Thursday afternoon.

news.title: Man admits killing ex-wife’s sister, shooting her brother in Gwinnett County
news.summary: A Stone Mountain man pleaded guilty to killing his former sister-in-law and shooting her brother inside a Lilburn store in April 2024, according to the Gwinnett County District Attorney’s Office.

news.title: GBI investigates fatal police shooting of Newnan teen after foot chase
news.summary: An 18-year-old man was fatally shot by a Newnan police officer following a foot chase, the Georgia Bureau of Investigation reports.

news.title: 4 overdoses reported at Paulding County home before 12 arrests
18-year-old shot by Newnan police officer, killed after foot chase
news.summary: A Newnan police officer shot and killed an 18-year-old man early Saturday after a foot chase where the teen pulled a gun, state investigators said.

news.title: Wanted Tennessee attempted murder suspect arrested after I-20 chase ends
news.summary: Two wanted suspects are in custody after a police chase ended with a PIT maneuver on I-20 Tuesday night, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Officer hospitalized after two-vehicle crash on Highway 19/41 in Griffin
news.summary: A Clayton County police officer and another driver were taken to a local hospital Friday after a two-car collision on Highway 19/41 in Griffin.

news.title: SWAT officers enter DeKalb home, find gun but no suspect inside
news.summary: DeKalb County Police searched a home on Pleasant Point Drive for an armed suspect Thursday after occupants reported he was inside.

news.title: Most wanted auto crime suspect arrested, Atlanta police say
news.summary: One of Atlanta's most wanted auto crime suspects is in custody after officers spotted him walking in the middle of a street in southwest Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Mother of child killed during civil unrest in Atlanta fights candidate’s use of photo
news.summary: The mother of an 8-year-old girl murdered during civil unrest in 2020 is upset that the GOP nominee for governor is using her daughter’s photograph in a campaign mailer.

news.title: Metro Atlanta police department asks for more behavior health resources for crisis calls
news.summary: The police chief of Gwinnett County is asking for more money for the department’s behavioral health unit.

news.title: 'Is this about the girl?': Man convicted of Acworth attempted rape
news.summary: A Cherokee County jury convicted Sedric Charles Williams of attempted rape and sexual battery following a four-day trial in Canton.

news.title: 'Painful moment,' attorney says, as Florida deputy found not guilty in 2024 shooting of US airman from metro Atlanta
news.summary: Attorney Ben Crump issued a statement on the verdict Friday in the case involving the deadly shooting of Roger Fortson in May 2024.

news.title: Fourth suspect arrested in April homicide on Donald Lee Hollowell Pkwy.
news.summary: Gerald Deese was taken into custody on Oct. 1 and charged with murder and aggravated assault, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Stone Mountain man gets life without parole in fatal Lilburn shooting
news.summary: The shooting killed Tigist Lulesegud, 57, and injured her 65-year-old brother, Abebe D. Yeshetela.
